J&K Police arrest three Lashkar-e-Taiba OGWs for facilitating terror movement

Jammu and Kashmir Police have arrested three over-ground workers (OGWs) linked to Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) in Rajouri district. According to police, these individuals had been active for several years and facilitated the movement of terrorists across Rajouri and Reasi districts in the Jammu division, extending through the Pir Panjal region to Shopian district in Kashmir. The arrests were made recently in Rajouri.
